name: normalize
description: Target a specific loudness level (LUFS) via ffmpeg loudnorm two-pass

input.description: Video or audio file to normalize

params.name: target
params.description: Platform preset. youtube = -14 LUFS, podcast = -16 LUFS, broadcast = -23 LUFS.

params.name: lufs
params.description: Target LUFS. Used only when --target is 'custom'.

params.name: measure-only
params.description: Print pass-1 loudness stats as JSON and exit; skip pass 2 entirely (no file written, --out not needed).

params.name: window-in
params.description: Measure only this window of --input (source seconds), applied as ffmpeg seek flags on the measurement pass itself — native sample rate and channel count are preserved. Must be paired with window-out, and requires measure-only (windowed encoding is not supported).

params.name: window-out
params.description: End of the measurement window in source seconds. Must be paired with window-in.
